reason: The stated invariant 'x high bytes are under 128 but for the start-up view's &FF' is false, and the new code differs from the old where it fails. Observer mode (game.6502 observer_mode_loop) lets LEFT scroll past the world start with no limit. After 256 columns left of the start view right_high becomes &FE (scroll_screen_left DECs it), and left_high is &FE. That path calls add_enemy_helicopters with A=&FE, which stores x_high=&FE in the helicopter slots 10-21 (not drawn, rec_xh=&FF). Old: BMI classified (negative = nothing there), so never listed. New: BMI is gone; A=&FE < right+1=&FF, so it falls into near_screen, INC A gives &FF, CMP left_high (&FE) sets C, BCS listed, so the slot is listed and mark_to_draw may now draw it. Any x_high in 128..right (right >= &80, only reachable that way) behaves the same. The ren_i move to .shown_y is fine (only .shown reads it; mark_to_draw and gather set their own), the right_high wrap to 0 at &FF is fine (left_high is &FE or &FF then, so old also classified everything), and viewport_right_high is not written inside the loop or by the IRQ. Byte count is also wrong: setup is LDA zp(2)+INC(1)+STA abs(3)=6, STX moves (0), removed BMI(2)+BEQ(2) and CMP abs(3)->CMP imm(2) (-1) = -5, so net +1 byte, not -2 (the argument's own text says the code after slides by +2, contradicting the -2 claim).
